string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_summary
string.translation: Live background blur for the keyboard panel.
為鍵盤面板加入即時背景模糊。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_error_summary
string.translation: Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_enabled_summary
string.translation: Requires Android 12 or later and a device that supports cross-window blur.
限 Android 12 以上且裝置支援跨視窗模糊。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_transparency_help_title
string.translation: 背景透明度與磨砂效果

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_transparency_help_summary
string.translation: If the theme background is opaque, select Custom under Background transparency below and increase its value to reveal the blur effect. Official themes use opaque backgrounds by default, so their background transparency also needs to be overridden. Changing Key transparency alone does not make the background transparent.
若主題背景不透明，請將下方「背景透明度」設為「自訂」，並提高透明度，才能顯示磨砂效果。官方主題預設使用不透明背景，也需要覆寫背景透明度。僅調整「按鍵透明度」不會讓背景變透明。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_radius_summary
string.translation: Set live blur strength from 1 to 100.
設定即時模糊強度，範圍為 1 到 100。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_transparency_summary
string.translation: Follow the theme or set a custom keyboard background transparency.
選擇跟隨主題，或使用自訂鍵盤背景透明度。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_opacity_summary
string.translation: Set keyboard background transparency from 0 to 100%.
設定鍵盤背景透明度，範圍為 0 到 100%。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_key_transparency_summary
string.translation: Follow the theme or adjust key backgrounds while keeping labels and icons clear.
選擇跟隨主題，或調整按鍵背景透明度，保留文字與圖示清晰。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_key_opacity_summary
string.translation: Set key background transparency from 0 to 100%.
設定按鍵背景透明度，範圍為 0 到 100%。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_seamless_nav_bar_summary
string.translation: Extend frosted glass into the bottom navigation area and adjust navigation button colors; turn this off if the buttons are hard to see or the bottom area displays incorrectly.
讓磨砂玻璃延伸到底部導覽區並調整導覽按鈕顏色；若導覽按鈕看不清楚或底部顯示異常，可關閉。

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_faq_not_working_title
string.translation: 為什麼磨砂玻璃沒有效果？

string.name: gboard_patches_frosted_glass_faq_flickering_title
string.translation: Why do I see flickering while typing on Pixel phones?
為什麼 Pixel 手機輸入文字時會閃爍？

string.name: gboard_patches_error_header_summary
string.translation: This settings page failed to load and was safely disabled.
這個設定頁載入失敗，已安全停用。

string.name: gboard_patches_error_row_summary
string.translation: The host app stayed alive. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
宿主 App 仍維持運作。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_fatal_fallback_summary
string.translation: This screen hit an internal error and was safely disabled. Gboard stays alive. Reopen settings and try again.
這個畫面發生內部錯誤，已安全停用。Gboard 仍維持運作。請重新開啟設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_search_no_results_summary
string.translation: Try a shorter or different keyword.
試試較短或其他關鍵字。

string.name: gboard_patches_restart_failed
string.translation: Gboard could not be restarted. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
無法重新啟動 Gboard。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定後再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_group_keyboard_tools_summary
string.translation: Incognito mode, long-press shortcuts, editing tools, quick insert, web search, and calculator.
無痕模式、長按快捷操作、編輯工具、快速插入、網頁搜尋與計算機。

string.name: gboard_patches_group_ai_voice_summary
string.translation: AI writing tools, advanced voice typing, and Bluetooth microphone.
AI 撰寫工具、進階語音輸入與藍牙麥克風。

string.name: gboard_patches_group_keyboard_layout_summary
string.translation: Expression tab order, emoji size, Access Points menu, split keyboard, rounded corners, custom themes, and frosted glass.
表情符號與貼圖分頁排序、表情符號大小、工具列選單、分割鍵盤、圓角鍵盤、自訂主題與磨砂玻璃。

string.name: gboard_patches_group_keyboard_empty_summary
string.translation: This build does not include any keyboard settings features.
這個 build 沒有包含任何鍵盤設定功能。

string.name: gboard_patches_quick_insert_error_title
string.translation: 快速插入設定無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_quick_insert_error_summary
string.translation: The Quick Insert settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
快速插入設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_close_proactive_suggestions_error_title
string.translation: 關閉建議按鈕設定無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_close_proactive_suggestions_error_summary
string.translation: The dismiss suggestions button settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
關閉建議按鈕設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_access_point_count_error_title
string.translation: 頂端工具列項目數量設定無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_access_point_count_error_summary
string.translation: The top toolbar item count settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
頂端工具列項目數量設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_access_point_count_enabled_summary
string.translation: Force-stop and restart Gboard for the change to take effect.
需要強制停止並重新啟動 Gboard 才會生效。

string.name: gboard_patches_access_point_count_value_summary
string.translation: Enter the number of toolbar items, from 3 through 8.
輸入工具列項目數量，範圍為 3 到 8。

string.name: gboard_patches_access_point_count_value_error
string.translation: Enter a whole number from 3 through 8.
請輸入 3 到 8 的整數。

string.name: gboard_patches_developer_options_summary
string.translation: Open Developer options and the Flag Editor.
開啟 開發人員選項 與 Flag 編輯器。

string.name: gboard_patches_developer_options_package_warning_title
string.translation: 不支援的 Gboard 套件名稱

string.name: gboard_patches_developer_options_package_warning_message
string.translation: The current Gboard package is %1$s. Gboard Patches supports only the official package com.google.android.inputmethod.latin and dev.jason.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin. Mixing Gboard builds from multiple sources may cause instability.
目前的 Gboard 套件名稱是 %1$s。Gboard Patches 只支援官方套件名稱 com.google.android.inputmethod.latin 與 dev.jason.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin，混用多個來源的 Gboard 可能導致不穩定。

string.name: gboard_patches_developer_options_launch_failed
string.translation: Unable to open Developer options for %1$s.
無法開啟 %1$s 的開發人員選項。

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_summary
string.translation: Controls Gboard AI Writing Tools availability, keyboard support, and backend routing.
控制 Gboard AI 撰寫工具的可用性、鍵盤支援與後端路由。

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_error_title
string.translation: AI 撰寫工具無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_error_summary
string.translation: The AI Writing Tools settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
AI 撰寫工具設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_enabled_title
string.translation: 啟用 AI 撰寫工具

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_enabled_summary
string.translation: Force-show Corrections & suggestions > Writing tools > Show writing tools icon in suggestion strip while typing. Force-stop and restart Gboard for changes to take effect.
強制顯示 修正和建議 > 撰寫工具 中的 輸入時在建議列顯示撰寫工具圖示。強制停止並重新啟動Gboard生效

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_all_keyboards_summary
string.translation: When enabled, force writing tools to work on every keyboard. Force-stop and restart Gboard for the change to take effect.
開啟後，會強制把撰寫工具在所有鍵盤生效。需要強制停止並重新啟動 Gboard 才會生效。

string.name: gboard_patches_ai_writing_tools_backend_type_summary
string.translation: If you select AI CORE or ASTREA, your account or device must be eligible to enable it.
如果選擇AI CORE或是ASTREA，你的帳號或裝置必須要有權限才能啟用

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_summary
string.translation: Adjusts clipboard retention, item limits, preview lines, metadata labels, order index, and columns.
調整剪貼簿保留時間、項目數量上限、預覽行數、metadata 標籤、排序索引與欄數。

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_error_summary
string.translation: The clipboard settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
剪貼簿設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_card_preview_limit_title
string.translation: Show only the first 1,000 characters on clipboard cards
剪貼簿卡片只顯示前1000字

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_card_preview_limit_summary
string.translation: Gboard puts the entire text into each card on the Clipboard page and renders it repeatedly, which can make vertical scrolling stutter. This switch makes each clipboard card actually hold only the first 1,000 characters while it is rendered to avoid scrolling lag.
由於 Gboard 官方在剪貼簿頁面中會把整個 text 放在卡片中並且重複渲染，會導致上下滑動卡頓，所以這個開關會讓剪貼簿卡片實際只存前 1000 字元，避免上下滑動卡頓。

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_show_sensitive_content_summary
string.translation: Show the original text instead of dots for clipboard items marked sensitive by password managers, incognito browsing, or other apps. This can expose passwords and private data on screen.
對密碼管理器、無痕瀏覽或其他 App 標記為敏感的剪貼簿項目，顯示原始文字而非圓點。這可能會讓密碼與私人資料直接顯示在畫面上。

string.name: gboard_patches_clipboard_content_limit_summary
string.translation: Customize the maximum character count for each text clipboard item. Official default: 20000
自訂每個文字剪貼簿項目的最大字元數。官方預設為20000

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_show_expiry_countdown_summary
string.translation: Shows the remaining retention time above each clipboard item.
在每個剪貼簿項目上方顯示剩餘保留時間。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_show_creation_time_summary
string.translation: Shows when each clipboard item was created in the current device time zone.
以目前裝置時區顯示每個剪貼簿項目的建立時間。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_show_order_index_summary
string.translation: Shows [1], [2], and so on above each clipboard item.
在每個剪貼簿項目上方顯示 [1]、[2] 等標記。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_order_index_direction_summary
string.translation: Controls whether [1] marks the newest or oldest clipboard item.
控制 [1] 代表最新還是最舊的剪貼簿項目。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_clipboard_columns_summary
string.translation: Controls how many columns the clipboard grid uses.
控制剪貼簿網格使用幾欄。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_content_max_lines_summary
string.translation: Controls how many preview lines each clipboard item can show before truncation.
控制每個剪貼簿項目在截斷前最多顯示幾行預覽文字。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_ttl_summary
string.translation: Controls how long unpinned clipboard items are retained.
控制未釘選的剪貼簿項目保留時間。

string.name: gboard_patches_pref_max_count_summary
string.translation: Limits how many unpinned clipboard items stay visible at the same time.
限制同時可見的未釘選剪貼簿項目數量。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_summary
string.translation: Choose whether Gboard settings use the new or legacy settings style.
選擇 Gboard 設定使用新樣式或舊樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_header_summary
string.translation: Control whether Gboard settings use the new or legacy settings experience. Reopen Gboard settings after changing this option.
控制 Gboard 設定使用新的或舊的設定體驗。變更後請重新開啟 Gboard 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_error_summary
string.translation: The homepage selector failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
首頁切換器載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_safeguard_summary
string.translation: This Android version does not expose the expected expressive runtime. New still remains selectable, but it runs under crash recovery protection.
這個 Android 版本沒有提供預期的 expressive runtime。仍可選擇新樣式，但會受當機復原保護。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_trial_armed_summary
string.translation: Open Gboard settings within %1$d seconds. If nothing launches in that window, it falls back to Legacy automatically.
請在 %1$d 秒內開啟 Gboard 設定。如果在這段時間內沒有成功啟動，會自動回退到舊樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_recovery_summary
string.translation: The previous New settings launch did not finish cleanly. Legacy stays active so you can reopen settings and retry safely.
上一次的新設定樣式啟動沒有正常完成。舊樣式會維持啟用，讓你能安全地重新開啟設定並重試。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_trial_expired_summary
string.translation: The New launch window expired before Gboard opened its settings page. Legacy stays active until you choose New again.
新樣式的啟動視窗已過期，Gboard 尚未成功開啟設定頁。舊樣式會維持啟用，直到你再次選擇新樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new_recovered
string.translation: The previous New launch crashed. Legacy stays active until you switch modes or choose New again to retry.
前一次的新樣式啟動發生當機。舊樣式會維持啟用，直到你切換模式，或再次選擇新樣式重試。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new_expired
string.translation: The New launch window expired. Choose New again, then open Gboard settings within 10 seconds to retry.
新樣式的啟動視窗已過期。請再次選擇新樣式，並在 10 秒內開啟 Gboard 設定重試。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new_armed
string.translation: Open Gboard settings within 10 seconds. If the launch crashes or never starts, it falls back to Legacy automatically.
請在 10 秒內開啟 Gboard 設定。如果啟動當機或沒有成功開始，會自動回退到舊樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new_guarded
string.translation: New stays available on this Android version, but it runs with automatic fallback protection if the settings launch fails.
在這個 Android 版本上仍可使用新樣式，但如果設定啟動失敗，會自動回退保護。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_new
string.translation: Always use the new settings style. Reopen Gboard settings to apply.
永遠使用新設定樣式。變更後請重新開啟 Gboard 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_legacy
string.translation: Always use the legacy settings style. Reopen Gboard settings to apply.
永遠使用舊設定樣式。變更後請重新開啟 Gboard 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_mode_summary_auto
string.translation: Follow Gboard automatic selection. Reopen Gboard settings after switching modes.
跟隨 Gboard 的自動選擇。切換模式後請重新開啟 Gboard 設定。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_current_summary_guarded
string.translation: Legacy settings style is active right now because New is being held back by the safety guard.
目前實際啟用的是舊設定樣式，因為安全保護暫時阻擋了新樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_current_summary_queued
string.translation: New settings style is queued for the next Gboard settings launch.
新設定樣式已排入下一次 Gboard 設定啟動。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_current_summary_protected
string.translation: New settings style is selected with crash recovery protection on this Android version.
在這個 Android 版本上已選擇新設定樣式，並啟用當機復原保護。

string.name: gboard_patches_settings_homepage_current_summary_default
string.translation: %1$s settings style is active right now.
目前啟用的是 %1$s 設定樣式。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_title
string.translation: 表情符號、貼圖與 GIF 分頁順序

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_summary
string.translation: Reorder the bottom tabs in Gboard\'s Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel.
重新排序 Gboard「表情符號、貼圖與 GIF」面板底部的分頁。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_header_summary
string.translation: Controls the bottom tab order used by Gboard\'s Emojis, stickers & GIFs panel.
控制 Gboard「表情符號、貼圖與 GIF」面板底部的分頁順序。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_error_title
string.translation: Emojis, stickers & GIFs tab order unavailable
表情符號、貼圖與 GIF 分頁順序無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_error_summary
string.translation: The footer order screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
底部分頁順序畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_reorder_summary
string.translation: Drag the handle to move tabs.

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_empty_summary
string.translation: No tabs available in this build.
這個 build 沒有可用的分頁。

string.name: gboard_patches_symbol_footer_reset_confirm_message
string.translation: Restore the default Emojis, stickers & GIFs tab order?
要還原表情符號、貼圖與 GIF 的預設分頁順序嗎？

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_summary
string.translation: Add a manual Incognito toolbar button and configure clipboard and voice typing behavior.
新增手動無痕模式按鈕，並設定無痕模式下的剪貼簿與語音輸入行為。

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_enabled_summary
string.translation: Adds an Incognito button to the Access Point toolbar. Force-stop and restart Gboard for the change to take effect.
啟用後會在 Access Point 工具列中新增 Incognito 按鈕。強制關閉並重新啟動 Gboard 後生效。

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_clipboard_title
string.translation: 無痕模式時啟用剪貼簿

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_clipboard_summary
string.translation: Allow Gboard to process new system clipboard changes while incognito is active. Applies when the keyboard is reopened.
允許 Gboard 在無痕模式中處理新的系統剪貼簿內容。重新開啟鍵盤後套用。

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_voice_title
string.translation: 無痕模式時啟用語音輸入

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_voice_summary
string.translation: Allow voice typing while incognito is active. Google services or the network may still be used. Applies when the keyboard is reopened.
允許在無痕模式中使用語音輸入。Google 服務或網路仍可能被使用。重新開啟鍵盤後套用。

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_error_title
string.translation: 無痕模式設定無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_manual_incognito_error_summary
string.translation: The incognito settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
無痕模式設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_summary
string.translation: Long-press designated letter keys to show Select all, Undo, Copy, Cut, Paste, and Redo actions.
長按指定字母鍵，顯示全選、復原、複製、剪下、貼上與重做操作。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_error_title
string.translation: 長按編輯快捷鍵無法使用

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_error_summary
string.translation: The Long-Press Editing Shortcuts settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
長按編輯快捷鍵設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_enabled_summary
string.translation: Reopen the keyboard or switch layouts to fully apply changes.
重新叫出鍵盤或切換鍵盤版面後會完整套用變更。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_globe_drag_title
string.translation: Hold and drag from globe key

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_globe_drag_summary
string.translation: Swipe from the globe key to A/Z/X/C/V/Y for editing actions.
從地球鍵滑到 A/Z/X/C/V/Y，執行編輯操作。

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_select_all_title
string.translation: Select all when nothing is selected

string.name: gboard_patches_long_press_quick_actions_select_all_summary
string.translation: When no text is selected, long-press C/X or drag from Globe to C/X to copy or cut all text in the input field.
未選取文字時，長按 C/X 或從地球鍵拖曳到 C/X，會複製或剪下輸入框內的全部文字。

string.name: gboard_patches_bluetooth_microphone_summary
string.translation: 語音輸入->使用藍芽麥克風

string.name: gboard_patches_bluetooth_microphone_error_summary
string.translation: The Bluetooth microphone settings screen failed to load. Reopen Gboard settings and try again.
藍芽麥克風設定畫面載入失敗。請重新開啟 Gboard 設定再試一次。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_summary
string.translation: Controls whether Advanced Voice Typing is forced on.
控制是否強制啟用進階語音輸入。

string.name: gboard_patches_advanced_voice_modes_summary
string.translation: Voice typing has three modes: Standard, Standard - Advanced features (colorful microphone), and Rambler. Standard - Advanced features requires the Dictation payload.
語音輸入分為三種：標準、標準-進階功能（彩色麥克風）以及 Rambler。「標準-進階功能」需要 Dictation payload。

string.name: language_models_summary
string.translation: Choose dictionary and prediction resources by language, and inspect observed versions.
按語言選擇字典與預測資源，並查看已觀察到的載入版本。

string.name: language_models_enabled_help
string.translation: Enable to use custom versions; disable to restore APK defaults. Restart Gboard after changes.
開啟使用自選版本；關閉恢復 APK 內建資源。變更後需重啟 Gboard。

string.name: language_models_hmm_help
string.translation: Traditional Chinese and other Chinese and Korean languages
繁體中文、其他中韓語言

string.name: language_models_delight_help
string.translation: English, German, Thai and more languages
英文、德文、泰文及更多語言

string.name: language_models_nwp_help
string.translation: American English · Next-word and multiword prediction
美式英文・下一詞與多詞預測

string.name: language_models_key_correction_help
string.translation: 美式英文・按鍵修正模型

string.name: language_models_saft_help
string.translation: English, German, Spanish and French · User-feature-cache resources
英、德、西、法語・使用者特徵快取輔助資源

string.name: language_models_hash_identity
string.translation: Resource version identified by the reviewed model file SHA-256
資源版號已依模型檔 SHA-256 識別

string.name: language_models_mozc_help
string.translation: Japanese · Main dictionary and language data
日文・主要字典與語言資料

string.name: language_models_grammar_help
string.translation: English, Spanish, French and Portuguese · Grammar correction
英、西、法、葡語・語法校正

string.name: language_models_pixel_disabled
string.translation: Pixel 2026-10-27・停用此 NWP 引擎

string.name: language_models_dictionary_languages_help
string.translation: The Delight selector chooses the overall catalog version. Its 890 language and variant entries each have their own dictionary version. Look up the dictionaries specified by each catalog; this does not select versions or enable languages.
Delight 選的是整份清單版本（大版本）；內部 890 個語言／分支各有自己的字典版號。此處只查詢各清單對應的字典版本，不會另外選版或啟用語言。

string.name: language_models_results_count
string.translation: Delight dictionaries: %1$d language and variant entries
Delight 字典版本（%1$d 個語言／分支）

string.name: language_models_hmm_about_title
string.translation: HMM · Chinese and Korean dictionaries and conversion
HMM・中韓字典與輸入轉換

string.name: language_models_hmm_about
string.translation: Dictionary and model resources for Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean and related input methods. Switching may affect word conversion, candidate ranking and continuation predictions for input such as Zhuyin and Pinyin.
繁中、簡中、韓文等輸入法使用的字典與模型資源。切換可能影響注音、拼音等輸入的字詞轉換、候選排序及接續預測。

string.name: language_models_delight_about
string.translation: Dictionaries and language models for English, German, Thai and many other languages. Switching may affect suggested vocabulary, spelling correction, candidate ranking and next-word suggestions. The selector chooses the overall dictionary catalog; each language and variant has its own dictionary version and may update at a different time.
英文、德文、泰文等多種語言使用的字典與語言模型。切換可能影響可建議的詞彙、拼字修正、候選排序與接詞建議。選擇的是整份字典清單版本；各語言與分支有各自的字典版號，也不一定同時更新。

string.name: language_models_nwp_about
string.translation: Next-word prediction: an additional American English engine that suggests following words from the text already entered. It does not replace the main dictionary; disabling it does not disable every source of next-word suggestions.
Next-word prediction，這裡是美式英文額外的接詞／多詞預測引擎，依已輸入內容建議後續詞語。它不替換一般字典；停用此引擎也不代表所有接詞建議都關閉。

string.name: language_models_key_correction_about_title
string.translation: 按鍵修正・修正觸發與輸入判斷

string.name: language_models_key_correction_about
string.translation: A Google American English TFLite model used for input-correction triggering, separate from the main dictionary. Presets apply the matching TFLite enable and key-routing flags together.
Google 的美式英文 TFLite 按鍵修正模型，參與輸入修正的觸發判斷，與一般字典分開。選項連同該來源的 TFLite 觸發開關及適用按鍵設定一起套用。

string.name: language_models_saft_about_title
string.translation: SAFT・使用者特徵快取輔助資源

string.name: language_models_saft_about
string.translation: Auxiliary models and biasing dictionaries retrieved by the Gboard user-feature-cache manager. This catalog provides American English, German, Spanish and French resources, rather than the main Traditional Chinese model. This selects resource configuration; Gboard controls usage conditions. Native SAFT version detection is not yet available.
Gboard 使用者特徵快取管理器取得的輔助模型與偏置字典。此清單提供美式英文、德文、西班牙文、法文資源，並非繁中主模型。這裡選擇資源配置，實際使用條件由 Gboard 控制；目前未提供 SAFT 原生載入版號偵測。

string.name: language_models_mozc_spell_about
string.translation: Separate data for Japanese spelling-correction suggestions. It is independent of the main kana-to-kanji dictionary. Selecting resources does not enable system spell checking.
日文拼寫校正使用的獨立資料，可能影響錯字修正建議。它與假名轉漢字的主要 Mozc 字典分開；選擇資源不會自動開啟系統拼寫檢查。

string.name: language_models_mozc_about
string.translation: Main dictionary and language data for Japanese input. Switching may affect vocabulary for kana-to-kanji conversion, conversion candidates and their ranking.
日文輸入的主要字典與語言資料。切換可能影響假名轉漢字的詞彙、轉換候選及其排序。

string.name: language_models_grammar_about
string.translation: Grammar correction resources for supported languages such as English, Spanish, French and Portuguese. These affect sentence error detection and correction suggestions. Selecting resources here does not enable the Grammar Checker feature.
英、西、法、葡語等支援語言的語法校正資源，影響句子錯誤偵測與修正建議。此處只選資源，不會自動開啟「語法校正」功能。

string.name: language_models_langid_about
string.translation: Identifies the likely language of multilingual input to help select suggestions from the appropriate language. It is not a dictionary and does not add input languages; switching may affect language decisions for multilingual suggestions.
辨識多語輸入內容較接近哪種語言，協助選用對應語言的候選。它不是字典，也不會新增可輸入的語言；切換可能影響多語候選的語言判斷。

string.name: language_models_restart_help
string.translation: Restart Gboard, open the relevant language keyboard, then check again.
請重啟 Gboard，開啟對應語言鍵盤後再查看。

string.name: language_models_loaded
string.translation: 原生語言模型載入成功

string.name: language_models_enrolled
string.translation: 原生輸入方案註冊成功

string.name: language_models_submitted
string.translation: Submitted to NWP engine; readiness is not yet confirmed
已提交至 NWP 引擎，尚未確認 Ready

string.name: language_models_search_hint
string.translation: Language name or locale, for example English, German, Thai, en-US
語言名稱或語系，例如英文、德文、泰文、en-US

string.name: language_models_refine_search
string.translation: No matching entry. Try another language name or locale.
沒有相符條目，請輸入其他語言名稱或語系。

string.name: language_models_unavailable
string.translation: 目前無法查詢字典版本。

string.name: language_models_details_help
string.translation: Confirmed loads and engine submission status.
已確認的載入及引擎提交狀態。

string.name: language_models_nwp_ready
string.translation: 原生 NWP 引擎已確認 Ready

string.name: language_models_expected_version
string.translation: The selected catalog specifies %1$d. Sync may still be pending, or another source may be active. Reopen the keyboard after sync.
所選清單的語言包版本為 %1$d。可能仍在同步或由其他來源提供；同步後請重開鍵盤再確認。

string.name: language_models_detection_scope_help
string.translation: Native load observation is available for HMM, Delight, NWP and key correction. Key-correction resource versions are identified by reviewed file SHA-256 values. Mozc main/spellchecker, Grammar, Lang-id and SAFT currently provide configuration selection without native version detection.
可偵測 HMM、Delight、NWP 及按鍵修正的原生載入；按鍵修正資源版號以已核對的檔案 SHA-256 識別。Mozc 主資料／拼寫校正、Grammar、Lang-id、SAFT 目前提供配置選擇，尚未偵測原生載入版號。

string.name: gboard_patches_group_more_summary
string.translation: Settings style, backup and restore, and developer options.
設定樣式、備份與還原、開發人員選項。

string.name: gboard_patches_group_more_empty_summary
string.translation: This build does not include any additional settings features.
這個 build 沒有包含其他設定功能。

string.name: language_models_observation_help
string.translation: Enabling restarts Gboard once to detect fresh model loads. Then open the keyboard preview.
開啟時會自動重新啟動 Gboard 一次，以偵測新的模型載入；接著請開啟鍵盤預覽。

string.name: language_models_observation_off
string.translation: Detection is off. Enable it to inspect the resources loaded by your keyboard.
偵測已關閉。開啟後即可查看鍵盤實際載入的資源。

string.name: language_models_observation_wait
string.translation: Waiting for model loads. Open the keyboard preview below; new observations appear here automatically. If none appear, use Restart Gboard above and open the preview again.
尚未收到模型載入事件。請用右下角開啟鍵盤預覽，新紀錄會自動顯示在此頁；若仍無紀錄，請按右上角重新啟動 Gboard 後再開啟預覽。

string.name: language_models_observation_restart_failed
string.translation: Detection is enabled, but Gboard could not restart automatically. Use Restart Gboard above, then open the keyboard preview.
偵測已開啟，但無法自動重新啟動 Gboard。請按右上角重新啟動 Gboard，再開啟鍵盤預覽。

string.name: gboard_patches_keypress_haptics_entry_summary
string.translation: Control keypress vibration intensity instead of duration.
將按鍵震動由持續時間改為力度控制。

string.name: gboard_patches_keypress_haptics_summary
string.translation: Control keypress vibration intensity instead of duration.\nPreferences > Vibration strength on keypress.
將按鍵震動由持續時間改為力度控制。\n偏好設定 > 按鍵時的振動強度。

string.name: gboard_patches_keypress_haptics_supported
string.translation: 此裝置支援點擊觸覺回饋

string.name: gboard_patches_keypress_haptics_unsupported
string.translation: This device does not support click haptics; Gboard keeps its original vibration
此裝置不支援點擊觸覺回饋，Gboard 將保留原有震動

string.name: gboard_patches_keypress_haptics_support_unknown
string.translation: Unable to check device support; Gboard still checks before playing
無法確認裝置支援狀態，播放時仍由 Gboard 檢查
